title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. Is zakah to be given separately for wife and husband's wealth? 5741 views Q. Can a person give zakah to his teacher (Ustad)? 3290 views Q. My question is about Zakat. I pay zakat ever year and like to pick one or two families who can benefit the most from it. However, as it happens, the zakat fulfills their temporary needs. They spend money quickly and are again in need (for example widows, children, etc). Many do not know how to make good use of money (to start a small business, open a shop, etc). 1. Can I invest the money (amount of annual zakat) on behalf of the needy and pay them the profit (they remain the owners of capital and can take it from me anytime)? 2. My father runs a trust. The trust makes investments in businesses and the profits are used for charity purposes. Can I pay my zakat to his trust? Can the trust invest my zakat and pay the profit in charity? 3. Can the trust open a separate account of investments for Zakat, invest it and help the needy and poor with the profits generated? Would really appreciate your answers. 1608 views Q. answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 40287 Country: United States of America Title: Zakah Question: For example: Last year, my bank balance was $5000. I paid zakah on that $5000. Now I have $10000 in my bank account (including the $5000 balance from last year). Do I need to pay zakah on the $5000 that was accumulated this year, or the entire $10000 in the bank? Can you please reply as soon as possible? Answer ID: 40287 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 646/603/N=1433) Zakah is wajib each year; hence you will have to pay the zakah of 10 thousand dollars. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
